**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline.**

§ 1 of the agreement contains an express anti-exclusivity statement: nothing creates an exclusive arrangement between AP and Kubient, and AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell it to third parties. I checked every "exclusive"/"sole" hit and searched for requirements commitments, rights of first refusal/offer, non-competes and "only through" sourcing language — none binds AP:

- p0002 — non-exclusive licence **to** AP, and only if AP elects to use Kubient's ad serving technology (voluntary use, not exclusivity);
- p0064 / p0065 / p0072 / p0073 — exclusive jurisdiction, trademark ownership, and entire-agreement/third-party-beneficiary boilerplate, all outside this rule.

The preferred element ("Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation") is already met verbatim, so the fallback narrowing mechanics are not needed and no change was proposed.
